title: Primary street setback area minimum 30% soft landscaping
text: C1.2.2 The primary street setback area is to provide a minimum 30% soft landscaping (Figure 1.2b).

replaces.note: not more than 50% impervious -> 30% soft landscaping (quantum falls, test changes)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Paved areas are excluded from soft landscaping (Figure 1.2b, p12). Part B C2.1(i) (street setback without car parking except visitors' bays) is deleted with no successor (ch3-017). R100-SL: no minimum (Table 2.10a), excluded by coding. Same as the Chapter 2 twin.
